limitations: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — NOT REAL BLUEBERRY ACCURACY

Ignored unmatched predictions do not count as detection FP but remain raw count errors.
No confidence intervals or independent real-world generalization claim.
Visible fruit count is not kg or a business maturity grade.
